title: A Survey of Safety on Large Vision-Language Models: Attacks, Defenses and Evaluations

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying benchmarks like AVIBench, which generates content bias Adversarial Visual-Instructions (AVIs) using black-box attack methods to evaluate model robustness.

Reviewing evaluation frameworks such as MLLMGuard and MultiTrust that employ red teaming techniques and bilingual evaluation datasets to assess bias, fairness, and overall trustworthiness in model outputs.
